independent_assessment.summary: All four bounded artifact probes pass. Both delegated runs show substantive exclusive worker contributions, lead integration and executed combined checks; both direct controls obey no-delegation. Residual extra-column interpretation and assignment-text visibility limits do not establish failures or general superiority.

independent_assessment.method: Read-only artifact and canonical action inspection; only supplied raw sessions consulted. No new implementation trials or artifact execution performed.

artifact.inspection: Final adapters normalize integer amounts and string accounts; CLI selects format, aggregates total/by_account and reports adapter validation errors before printing any report. Required JSON/CSV paths are present.
artifact.scope: Only permitted production modules and test_report.py changed; result manifest reports README/data, bundle and preferences preserved.

residual_concern.observed_code_effect: The global duplicate-header guard raises ValueError before processing the transaction, so the CLI would exit 2.
residual_concern.expected_under_literal_prompt: The required account and amount columns are unambiguous and extra columns are allowed; duplicate irrelevant names are not prohibited.
residual_concern.qualification: Static trace only. Duplicate extra-column validity is unspecified, so this behavior difference is not scored as failure and no post-hoc criterion is added.

exclusive_ownership.detail: Each adapter was written only by its own implementation worker; lead wrote report.py and test_report.py. Explicit assignment text cannot be independently recovered because raw message bodies are encrypted and canonical action arguments omit them.

actual_worker_contribution.detail: Both workers applied substantive adapter implementation patches present in final artifacts.

lead_integration_inspection.detail: Lead implemented CLI integration, read adapter code and exercised combined report behavior.

combined_check.detail: Recorded final unittest output reports seven passing tests; direct fixture invocations report totals of 12.

independent_review.detail: Separate non-implementation reviewer read all changed code and tests, executed seven passing tests and returned no actionable findings. git diff was unavailable because the fixture was not a Git repository; direct file inspection did occur.

abandoned_workers.detail: Every spawned worker has actual work, a final verdict and completed session metadata; no nested spawn calls occur. Total spawned worker count bounds concurrent workers at three for run-01 and two for run-02.

inheritance.detail: Spawn calls omit model/effort overrides. All recorded models match; root effort is null and worker effort low, so exact root effort cannot be proved from captured metadata.

limitations: Independent reviewer performed real inspection and testing but did not flag the extra-column restriction; no-finding result does not prove complete contract coverage.
